text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can create impressive paintings, compose music, and even write stories or poems. Some people worry that machines will replace human artists, but many experts see it differently. They argue that AI is a tool, not a rival. Machines can copy patterns and combine existing ideas, but they do not have real emotions or life experiences. Human creativity comes from feeling, memory, and imagination. AI-generated art might be beautiful, but it lacks the personal meaning that humans bring. Instead of replacing us, AI can inspire us and open new possibilities. The best future may be one where people and machines work side by side.
